szoveg_eredeti:
10k Starship launches/year is just from Starbase Louisiana

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Robin (@xdNiBoR); megjelent: 2026-10-27T20:30:38+00:00; link: https://x.com/xdNiBoR/status/2115179387494465821; média: 3 kép]
In a comment to the FAA, SpaceX says it wants to launch 10,000 times per year. 

The FAA asked for input on where to build new spaceports and how to give rocket launches priority in US airspace. They're preparing for 10,000 launches a year by 2035.

SpaceX replied that rockets aren't the bottleneck anymore, the FAA's outdated air traffic processes are. They created their own airspace tool (Cleared) that most major US airlines already get for free.

They also noted that Starbase Louisiana is designed for ~30 launches and reentries PER DAY (!!)
